method: Viewed each original-scene review sheet and both full-size typeset editions; compared captions against previously approved source readings.

notes.1: Authors' positions remain attributed; collaboration, activity categories, institutional risks and disclosure are kept distinct.
notes.2: Policy objectives, skills/standards, fiscal capacity and exit conditions match CEPS discussion; no outcome claim.
notes.3: Service journey and coordination difficulties shown; named owner and long-term budget explicitly presented as authors' proposal.
notes.4: Tax/survey definitions, metadata provenance and departmental responsibility accurately represented; decorative graphs carry no factual numbers.
notes.5: 182 survey responses, financing question 78, due diligence question 142 retained; percentages kept intact after reflow and actual visual recheck.
notes.6: 2024 baseline, 3 million yen threshold, draft status, corporate commitments and proposed five-year evaluation with annual follow-up retained.
